warnings.label: River Sow and River Penk
warnings.river: Sandyford Brook, Ridings Brook, Saredon Brook
warnings.message:
Forecast rising river levels overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on 04 September 2026 . 
Flooding may affect  low-lying land and roads adjacent to the River Sow between Great Bridgeford and Shugborough, the River Penk between Coven and Stafford, the Sandyford Brook, the Rising Brook, the Ridings Brook and the Saredon Brook. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded . 
This message will be updated by 5:00PM on 04 September 2026 or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: River Amber in Derbyshire
warnings.message:
Rising river levels overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on 04 September 2026 . 
Areas most at risk are low-lying agricultural land and roads along the River Amber around Ambergate. Heavy rainfall is forecast over the next 12 hours. River levels at Wingfield Park Gauge may rise rapidly due to the nature of the catchment 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water . 
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on 04 September 2026 or as the situation changes.
